EnableSdkPluginConfig.description: Controls applying the specified SdkPluginConfigs to generated context plugins. Default: false

SdkPluginConfigs.description: Context plugin configuration for each LanguageTemplate. Any field left out falls back to a value derived from the API spec. Default: null

PHP_GENERIC_LIB_V2.description: Context plugin configuration for the PHP SDK

CS_NET_STANDARD_LIB.description: Context plugin configuration for the C# SDK

JAVA_ECLIPSE_JRE_LIB.description: Context plugin configuration for the Java SDK

PYTHON_GENERIC_LIB.description: Context plugin configuration for the Python SDK

RUBY_GENERIC_LIB.description: Context plugin configuration for the Ruby SDK

GO_GENERIC_LIB.description: Context plugin configuration for the Go SDK

TS_GENERIC_LIB.description: Context plugin configuration for the TypeScript SDK

PluginId.description: Plugin manifest "name". Must be lowercase alphanumerics separated by hyphens. Default: a slug derived from the API name

PluginVersion.description: Plugin manifest "version". This is the plugin's own version, not the SDK's. Default: 0.1.0

Author.description: Plugin author. Name and email resolve together: supplying a name without an email omits the email rather than inheriting the default one. Default: APIMatic

PluginRepository.description: Plugin manifest "repository" — where the plugin itself is published. Omitted from the manifest entirely when not supplied; there is deliberately no default, since an inherited value would point every plugin at somebody else's repository.

Sdk.description: Where the SDK this plugin documents can be obtained

Repository.description: Source repository of the generated SDK, when it is published to one

Name.description: Published package id. Overrides the package name the generator derives, since this is what a consumer actually installs. Default: the generated package name

Url.description: Direct download or registry URL for the package. When present it becomes the install command the plugin's skills instruct against.
